name: Develop and cost a menu
description: Develop dishes for a target group, calculate food cost and prices and write menu texts.
input:
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DATA – entirely fictional, for trying things out only.

Business: bistro "The Example Mill", 40 seats, business park with many offices
Target group: office workers on their lunch break (45 minutes), want quick, fresh food, often vegetarian
Assignment: lunch menu with 6 dishes, at least 2 vegetarian and 1 vegan; changes every two weeks
Target food cost: at most 30 % of the net selling price; price range EUR 9.50 to 14.50 gross (7 % VAT)

Purchase prices (net):
- Chicken breast EUR 9.80/kg, minced beef EUR 8.90/kg, salmon fillet EUR 21.00/kg
- Pasta EUR 1.60/kg, rice EUR 1.90/kg, potatoes EUR 0.90/kg, lentils EUR 2.40/kg
- Seasonal vegetables on average EUR 2.80/kg, leaf salad EUR 4.50/kg, chickpeas EUR 2.20/kg
- Feta EUR 8.50/kg, cream EUR 3.20/l, coconut milk EUR 3.90/l, olive oil EUR 7.50/l
- Spices, herbs and small items a flat EUR 0.35 per portion

guide.problem: A menu has to please guests and pay off. The workflow develops dishes for a target group, calculates food cost and prices and writes appetising menu texts.
guide.flow: A chain of three agents: the concept developer puts together dishes with recipes, the costing calculates food cost and selling prices with the calculator tool, and the menu writer writes the menu. A quality check verifies target group, prices and the note on allergens. The result contains the costing and the menu.
guide.input: Type of business, target group, number and type of dishes, target food cost, price range and purchase prices. You can paste the purchase prices or attach them as a CSV or Excel file, as the sample file shows.
guide.result: A costing table with food cost and price per dish and a finished lunch menu with short descriptions, also as a Word file for layout and as an Excel file with the costing tables. Allergens and additives must be checked and labelled on the basis of the actual recipes.
guide.adapt: Attach your current purchase price list and describe your target group. Upload your standard recipes as knowledge and assign them to the costing; add house rules such as portion sizes in the concept developer. For the change every two weeks you can run the copy on a schedule.

concept.name: Concept developer
concept.description: Puts together suitable dishes with recipes and quantities.
concept.system: You are a head chef experienced in the lunch trade. Develop dishes that suit the target group and can be prepared and served in the time available. For each dish, give a name, a short description and a recipe per portion with quantities in grams or millilitres. Use mainly ingredients from the purchase list and mark ingredients that are not on the list.
concept.task:
Develop the dishes for this concept:

{{run.input}}

costing.name: Costing
costing.description: Calculates food cost and selling prices with the calculator tool.
costing.system: You are a costing specialist in hospitality. For each dish, use the calculator tool to calculate the food cost per portion from the recipe and purchase prices, the net price at a food cost of at most 30 % and the gross price with 7 % VAT, rounded to sensible menu prices. Check the price range and propose adjustments if a dish does not fit. Show everything in a table.

menu.name: Menu writer
menu.description: Writes the lunch menu with appetising descriptions.
menu.system: You write menus. For each dish, write an appetising name and a description of at most 20 words that suits the target group. Add the price, a vegetarian or vegan label and a note that allergens must be checked and labelled based on the recipes. Take prices only from the costing. Finally, repeat the costing table unchanged.

criteria.target_group: Dishes and texts clearly suit the described target group.
criteria.prices_match: All prices match the costing and lie within the price range.
criteria.allergen_note: The menu contains a note on checking and labelling allergens.

purchase_prices.label: Purchase prices as a file
purchase_prices.description: Optional: your purchase price list as CSV or Excel, at most 5 MB. Without a file, the prices in the text apply.
